subject.title: feat(android): add Wear real-time Talk controls

question: Should bundled Wear OS realtime Talk become a supported product surface now, including the additive Wear v1 operations and public Gateway/provider language parameter?
rationale: The implementation is credible and proven, but it permanently expands the bundled Wear experience and compatibility-sensitive protocol/API surfaces; repository evidence does not show explicit owner approval for that complete direction.

options.title: Sponsor with compatibility proof
options.body: Approve the bundled feature after adding or documenting mixed-version phone/watch behavior and confirming the additive language API contract.

options.title: Narrow the API scope
options.body: Keep Wear realtime Talk but remove or defer the cross-client language API additions if they are not required for the first supported release.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Hold or close this PR until the broader Wear companion product surface and upgrade contract are explicitly prioritized.

recommendation.title: Sponsor with compatibility proof
recommendation.body: Approve the bundled feature after adding or documenting mixed-version phone/watch behavior and confirming the additive language API contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The phone-owned Wear proxy and protocol foundation originated in their merged change, making them the strongest available owner for the next product-boundary decision.
